notes.title: Bloody Zombies | Update 1 Available Now!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28734688/6a7ca8b04831d86cd7a1baf147ef3490b2d07594.jpg

Happy Friday!
Thank you all so much for your feedback on Bloody Zombies! We've just released our first update which includes an Easy mode and minor fixes.

Patch Notes
Easy mode added:

6 lives instead of 3
Boss health reduced
All small medi packs switched for medium medi packs
Reviver zombie removed and replaced with ranged enemy

- Keyboard prompts now appear when playing with keyboard
- Hit range increased in Z depth
- Reviver Zombie now has a tip of how to kill it – explosive Kill Required appear above his head

Got any questions?
You can get in touch with us on the forum!

Need support?
Please contact support@ndreams.com if you're having trouble. Replies will be in English. Alternatively, leave a post in our dedicated support sub forum and one of the team will respond.
